readings: For films with film.length >= 112 minutes, treat all qualifying films as one group. Return a single row with two unrounded figures in this order: the average film.length, then the average of replacement_cost / rental_rate calculated separately for each film. Ignore missing values separately for each average, and return a missing value for an average if no values remain.

For films with film.length > 112 minutes, treat all qualifying films as one group. Return a single row with two unrounded figures in this order: the average film.length, then the average of replacement_cost / rental_rate calculated separately for each film. Ignore missing values separately for each average, and return a missing value for an average if no values remain.
queries:
SELECT
  AVG(length),
  AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate)
FROM film
WHERE length >= 112

SELECT
  AVG(length),
  AVG(replacement_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_rate, 0))
FROM film
WHERE length > 112
